meta.name: The Tinellis
meta.description: Marcelo Tinelli opens the doors of his mansion in Punta del Este to welcome his family and friends. He takes the opportunity to introduce them to his girlfriend, Milett, 30 years younger than him. However, the reaction of his daughters is not as expected, and it causes an emotional imbalance in the group a few months before a transcendental event: the wedding of Cande, Marcelo's second daughter.

videos.title: A Family Full of Illusions
videos.overview: Marcelo Tinelli arrives in Punta del Este to enjoy the vacation with his family after a long time apart. His daughters, Cande, Mica, and Juana, are waiting for him with their partners while they rest and plan their upcoming work year. But Marcelo has a surprise for them: the introduction of Milett, his new girlfriend. After only a few hours of living together, the first conflicts explode.

videos.title: A Family Getting Confused
videos.overview: The conflict between Milett and Mimi shakes the family peace hours before one of the most iconic parties in Punta. A very obsessive Marcelo is in charge of the organization of the event and does not plan to suspend it despite the fight. While Tirri tries to repair relations, Cande faces unexpected adversities at a concert and begins to suspect the presence of bad energies in the house.

videos.title: A Family That is Broken
videos.overview: Mica, Cande, and Juana take advantage of Marcelo, Milett, and Tirri's departure to live in the mansion without restrictions or rules. They gather strength and decide to tell their father things they don't like about Milett. They also assume that the Peruvian actress will not return to Uruguay, although they may be surprised.

videos.title: A Family Open to Dialogue
videos.overview: Vacations in Punta del Este are coming to an end, and Tirri's birthday party on a yacht is a good excuse to leave the bad times behind. However, after the talk with their father, the Tinellis are analyzing Milett's behavior in detail. Marcelo receives bad news about Cande's wedding gift just before the most uncomfortable dinner of the whole vacation.

videos.title: An Uncomfortable Family
videos.overview: Marcelo organizes a trip to Mendoza to check on Cande's wedding present. The girls surprise him with a single condition that forces his father to face an awkward moment with Milett. "The Boss" has to make a difficult call and asks Tirri for help. Back in Buenos Aires, the tension that seemed to have disappeared flares up again.

videos.title: A Family Within a Family
videos.overview: Marcelo meets Soledad Aquino, his first wife, and Mica and Cande's mother. The upcoming wedding has them all more connected and moved than ever. With emotions running high, Marcelo faces the finale of his TV show and the uncertainty of what will come next. An unexpected emotional setback with his children makes him rethink some decisions.

videos.title: A Family in a Cold War
videos.overview: The family travels to Mendoza without partners. However, everyone feels that this arrangement will be short-lived and prepares for a surprise that finally arrives. Marcelo takes the opportunity to work further on Cande's wedding present, which gets more and more complicated. Tirri decides to stay out of the conflicts between Marcelo and his daughters, which makes everyone angry with him.

videos.title: A Happy Family
videos.overview: The "no couples" pact gets broken when someone else lands in Mendoza. The silent battle ends and the whole family can relax and enjoy the last day of the trip. A touching surprise from Marcelo leaves his daughters and Tirri with heart palpitations. The day of Cande and Coti's wedding arrives, and the whole Tinelli family experiences the most emotional moment.
